svg.text: RSUD Haji Provinsi Jawa Timur • End-to-end service design • 19 October 2026
H+1 date assigned by the server.
Reserve main place or join FIFO.
Hold remains while payment is due.
Registration FIFO is not this queue.
Record patient IN and OUT times.
Wait for all required unit results.
Verified events confirm a held place.
MCU doctor uploads a CSV batch.
Validate rows and review the preview.
Notify patient when document is ready.
One controlled record model spans the service; PostgreSQL is the authoritative database.
Only the registration backend is connected today. Most clinical screens use local browser state.
After staff validates the arriving patient
More examinations: re-evaluate the next eligible unit
100 main places = held + confirmed. 50 FIFO waiting places are not extra confirmed exams.
Only H+1, using Asia/Jakarta. Operator opens the service date; patients cannot choose a date.
Final submission holds a place. Owner cancellation releases it and promotes FIFO.
One unfinished application per account; one active registration per account / service date.
Duplicate NIK per service date is rejected. No automatic hold-expiry timer is implemented.
Payment provider, fees, refund / reconciliation rules, and hold expiry or abandonment policy.
Production account verification, staff access by role / unit, and medical-result delegation.
Clinical scheduling constraints, unit durations / travel times, official services and tariffs.
SIMRS / identity interfaces, notification contracts, opening hours and operational exceptions.
Payment confirmation and official queue-number issuance remain planned; no latency SLA set.
